questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work areas ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and drive carefully as you approach a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks cross at a steep angle, so the undercarriage of low vehicles may drag or get stuck.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a winding road is ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill grade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead directing traffic in a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Be prepared to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A lane is ending ahead. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic. Warning signs are yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is prohibited. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You are approaching a divided highway. Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: The overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians may be crossing here. Slow down and be ready to stop for people in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles may be present in this area. Watch for them and be prepared to share the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Be extra careful in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce speed and avoid sudden braking or sharp turns. Keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used when turn signals are not available. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals an intention to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and then swings it down to their side, it signals riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park in this area. Regulation signs display rules that drivers must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.
